description: This Java class 'PotCommand' provides a UI component for controlling a potentiometer (pot) resistance value in an engine control simulation, including UI elements, event handling, and command issuance to an external control queue.

classes.name: PotCommand
classes.description: A UI widget for setting and displaying potentiometer resistance values, integrated with control commands and voltage calculations.

methods.name: PotCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI components for a specific potentiometer channel.

methods.name: requestPotChange
methods.description: Sends a command to change the potentiometer resistor to a specified resistance.

methods.name: getPotResistance
methods.description: Calculates the resistance value needed based on desired output voltage and reference voltage.

methods.name: getRbyD
methods.description: Converts a resistance value to a dial value (digital resistance setting).

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDivider3
methods.description: Computes the resistance in a voltage divider based on output voltage, input voltage, and the R2 resistance.
